title: Billing Signal Synthesizer: per-route/model/customer cost & latency mapping
creator: Liam Chen
description: Build a durable service that synthesizes billing signals by combining telemetry from request routing, per-model execution profiles, and tenant metadata to produce per-route, per-model, and per-customer cost & latency breakdowns. This service will feed the Console UI and cost analytics pipelines, enable chargeback, and power alerting for regressions in unit economics. The goal is high-precision attribution (target: >95% of billed units accounted for) while keeping compute and storage overhead within the console analytics budget. The design emphasizes reproducibility, deterministic attribution, and graceful degradation when upstream telemetry is partial.
acceptance_criteria: Service produces a daily and near-realtime view of cost+latency by (route, model, customer) with documented schema and sample payloads
Computed attributions reconcile with raw invoicing within 5% for a 30-day sample workload
APIs: a realtime endpoint (max 2s p95 compute) for Console and a batched export to analytics S3/warehouse
Fallback behavior defined when KV-cache or kernel telemetry is missing: apply model-profile defaults and tag with "unresolved_profile"
Automated tests and integration tests run in CI; end-to-end validation job comparing with bill-run completes successfully
Dashboard in Console shows per-route latency/cost slices and a drift alert when weekly deviation >10%
comments: 2025-01-29 - Liam Chen: Kickoff meeting notes attached to Confluence design. Decided on canonical keys: tenant_id, route_id, model_variant, request_hash. Agreed to keep mapping deterministic and idempotent.

2025-02-05 - Aisha Kapoor: PoC completed for combining routing logs + model execution profile samples. Observed ~7% variance vs. naive per-token multiply; variance drivers: batching and cache hits. Next: incorporate KV cache hit telemetry and batch size histograms.

2025-02-18 - Eng Peer Review (Sofia Martinez): Raised concern about storing per-request metadata due to high cardinality. Recommendation: materialize aggregated slices at 1-minute granularity and keep sampled raw traces (1/1000). Updated design accordingly.
2025-02-25 - Data Eng (Miguel Alvarez): Proposed export format for warehouse (Parquet, partitioned by date, tenant, route). Proposed schema revision v2 in Confluence.

2025-03-01 - Aisha Kapoor: Implemented the realtime compute path that pulls stream shards, applies model-profile multipliers, and emits proto payloads. Benchmarks: p95 latency 1.7s on t3-standard dev machine for 500 RPS equivalent simulation. Open PR: runtime#4321.

2025-03-03 - QA (Rina Patel): Started integration tests against billing-sandbox. Found edge case when model_variant field missing — attribution falls back to 'model:unknown' and tags customer for follow-up. Created ticket ENG-128789 to add instrumentation.

2025-03-04 - Product (Daniel O'Neal): Requested a customer-facing note in Console that explains approximations and confidence scores for computed estimates. Added acceptance criterion to include confidence annotation in payloads.
risk_mitigation: Cardinality risk: aggregate to 1-minute buckets and keep only top-k routes per tenant
Telemetry gaps: tag outputs with confidence and fall back to model-profile defaults
Cost risk: run sampling and incremental rollouts to limit extra storage and compute
Accuracy regressions: schedule nightly reconciliations against invoice-run and trigger rollback/fix playbook
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable for internal tenants and 5 pilot customers; monitor drift and latency
Phase 2 (opt-in): enable for 25% of production tenants (config flag); collect feedback and reconcile accuracy
Phase 3 (GA): default-on with docs, cost explainer, and migration guide for downstream dashboards
monitoring: p95 compute latency for realtime path
storage growth and S3 export latency
